desc: 铬银液态波面与硬光镜面高光，三角标尺语言与空白参数收口
leaf: 夜用护翼型软包卫生巾
name: 镜面银硬光护翼卫生巾款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：把源首屏的粉橘展台与卡通精灵换成硬光铬银波面上的立包加同框护翼巾片研究，用金属高光抢点击而不喊任何功效。
shots.textZone: top solid #0B0D10 headline plate plus three empty triangle-topped rails low at the right

shots.intent: 承接源页第 2 屏的三枚圆形图标位：改为墨黑场上三条银栏加实心三角的空位困扰条，症状句与百分比全部留空由买家自行代入。
shots.textZone: top headline plate plus one short blank rail under each of the three plates

shots.intent: 承接源页两枚红 VS 圆章对照：改成同一巾片在铬银面与黑玻璃两条场域上的同尺度硬切双栏，用场域差替代胜负章，不下任何结论。
shots.textZone: one blank base rail per half

shots.intent: 承接源页第 2 屏底部的巾面特写与三枚功能图标：只拍面层压纹、中央压区与护翼折痕本身，机理断言与材料名一律删除。
shots.textZone: three hairline leader rails at the right, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页 01 编号的三张场景空图位：把生活方式改写为三块银面切片里的随身静物，用真实参照物锚定尺度，人物只留一只手腕以下的手且永不触碰敞开巾面。
shots.textZone: one headline plate under the tiles plus one short blank rail per tile

shots.intent: 补源页缺失的做工证据：以低角度掠射微距交代软包封口、侧封与袋体折痕本身，替掉源页第 4 屏的相框摆拍与离子数值。
shots.textZone: three hairline leader rails along the top, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页产品基本参数段：把成分行、毫米行与片数行全部换成空格栏，改由软包正反面加巾面正反侧五视图的实拍构造本身承担信任。
shots.textZone: one section line above the block plus five empty ruled rails read as bracketed label slots

shots.intent: 承接源页两枚重复的日用选款条：改为一行同族单位在铬银面上的低角度排布，差异全交给参考图自身承载，不写日夜标签与毫米片数。
shots.textZone: one short blank rail under each unit

shots.intent: 收口：用墨黑场加一条黑玻璃把整组收在一句主张与一个空动作位上，替掉源页尾的问答卡与会员二维码角标。
shots.textZone: lower band, one bracketed line plus one empty action slot

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous solidified liquid-metal ripple field #C7CDD4 whose crests break into #EEF1F4 specular lines and whose troughs fall to #6E7883, with one inset black glass strip #0B0D10 running across the lower third as the only product base plane; closing and pain-point screens swap in a plain #0B0D10 field with one hairline #C7CDD4 rule. The ripple is a solidified metallic sheet, never a liquid: never water, never milk, never oil, never a mirror pool, never a splash, wave crest, droplet or wet reflection. Never a photographed room, never a bathroom or bedroom, never a shelf, no plants or foliage, no arch window, no sky, no grass field, no clouds or petals, no candy-pink or coral gradient field.
style.direction: hard-edged chrome-metal commerce for feminine care
style.iconSystem: solid #FF2E88 filled equilateral triangles riding on a single hairline #C7CDD4 rule as the only icon language: triangle index tabs at plate corners, triangle-topped leader lines ending in a small solid square terminal, empty triangle-headed label plates and blank rectangular seal frames edged in #C7CDD4. No dashed die-cut outlines, no circles or outlined discs, no water-droplet pictogram, no leaf, shield, flame, sun, tick, cross, ribbon, star or badge glyph, no gradient icons, no 3D pictograms, no numerals or letters inside any marker.
style.lightingSystem: one hard studio key near 6000K entering from camera-left about 45 degrees above, so the chrome crests break into crisp broken specular edges and every object throws one tight short shadow toward camera-right; a black flag on the right keeps the specular line unbroken; no front fill, no soft wrap, no long raking shadow. Macro and edge screens swap the key for one narrow hard band skimming from camera-left along the surface so each embossed ridge catches its own thin specular line; the closing screen uses a narrow side sweep from camera-left with one tight shadow toward the lens. Contact shadows are always believable, the product never floats and never hovers above the glass strip.
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent hard-edged chrome-metal visual system for feminine-care e-commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of solidified liquid-metal ripple field #C7CDD4 with #EEF1F4 crest highlights and #6E7883 troughs, black glass base strip #0B0D10, plain #0B0D10 closing field and one hot accent #FF2E88; cool 6000K treatment; one wide geometric sans family, headline set heavy in #EEF1F4 inside a solid #0B0D10 plate with wide tracking and one small uppercase #C7CDD4 kicker rail, Chinese copy always inside 「」 brackets only; background system limited to the chrome ripple sheet plus one black glass strip, the ripple always solidified, never water, milk, oil, a mirror pool, a splash or a droplet, never a photographed room, never foliage, an arch window, sky, clouds or petals, never a candy-pink or coral gradient; lighting system of one hard key near 6000K from camera-left about 45 degrees above with crisp broken specular edges on every chrome crest, one tight short shadow toward camera-right, a black flag on the right and no front fill, narrow hard grazing band only on edge and macro screens, always a believable contact shadow and never a floating product; surfaces limited to the chrome ripple sheet, the black glass strip and one plain dark board, no marble, wood, tile, paper, card stock, linen or towel weave, pedestal or wire cage; icon system of solid #FF2E88 filled triangles on a single hairline #C7CDD4 rule, triangle index tabs, triangle-topped leader lines with small square terminals and blank #C7CDD4-edged seal frames, no dashed die-cut outlines, no discs, no droplet pictogram, no leaf, shield, sun, tick or badge glyph, no numerals inside any marker; the pad keeps its reference outline, wing form, wing crease, surface quilting, central embossed zone, edge seams, back sheet and colourway, the soft pack keeps its silhouette, gusset, seal edge and printed placement with no invented legible lettering; product is always a clean pack-and-pad study on the glass strip or the ripple, never on or beside a body, never on underwear, human presence limited to one cropped wrist-and-hand on the single handling screen and never touching an open pad surface; every claim slot, grid rail and seal frame stays empty; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent light direction, no mismatched icon styles, no medical or antibacterial claim, no hypoallergenic or gynaecologist-tested wording, no material composition, no absorbency figure, no thickness numeral, no pad count, no millimetre size, no registration or certification mark, no price or QR code.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #EEF1F4, #C7CDD4, #6E7883, #0B0D10 and #FF2E88
no candy-pink or coral gradient field, no arch window, no sky or grass, no foliage, clouds or petals, no cartoon fairy mascot
no medical, therapeutic, treatment or prevention wording of any kind

no registration number, disinfection or health licence code, execution-standard code, certification, lab report, test seal or stamp
no price, discount, coupon, shipping promise, membership corner badge, QR code, shop or platform wording, no star rating, sales figure or survey percentage
no depiction of menstruation, no blood, no fluid, no splash, droplet or wet reflection, no stain on product, glass, ripple or garment, no calendar period-day marking, no flow or leakage wording
no product on or against a body, no underwear or garment worn, no face, no identifiable person, no full hand or fingers on an open pad surface
no soft long raking shadow, no front fill light, no mixed fonts, no random photographic backgrounds, no change of key direction between shots
style.presentationRules: the pad keeps the reference outline, wing form, wing crease, surface quilting, central embossed zone, edge seams, back sheet and colourway exactly; the soft pack keeps its own silhouette, gusset, seal edge, printed placement and colourway with no invented legible lettering and no restyled printed figure; products are photographed as clean pack-and-pad studies seated on the glass strip or the ripple, never worn, held, placed on or beside a body, garment or underwear; human presence is limited to one cropped wrist-and-hand only on the single handling screen and it never touches an open pad surface; every claim slot, seal frame and label plate stays empty; pack vertical edges stay strictly vertical.
style.surfaceSystem: solidified liquid-metal ripple sheet #C7CDD4 with #EEF1F4 crest highlights and #6E7883 troughs, one black glass strip #0B0D10 as base plane, one plain #0B0D10 board for closing screens. No marble, no wood, no tile, no paper or card stock, no linen or towel weave, no fur, no plaster pedestal, no ribbed cylinder plinth, no gold wire cage, no real liquid, no water mirror, no floor.
style.typography: one wide geometric sans family only; headline set heavy in #EEF1F4 letters inside a solid #0B0D10 plate with wide letter-tracking, preceded by one solid #FF2E88 triangle, with one small uppercase #C7CDD4 kicker rail above it; short ruled label rails only, no dense body paragraphs, no outlined bubble lettering, no rounded cartoon type, no handwritten script, no narrow condensed grotesque.
